create_hsigmoid_default: create an HSigmoid module with default parameters to apply hard sigmoid activation on a tensor
create_hsigmoid_custom_params: create an HSigmoid module with custom bias divisor min_value and max_value parameters
run_hsigmoid_forward: run the forward pass of an HSigmoid module on a PyTorch tensor input
review_hsigmoid_clamp: review the HSigmoid forward method to understand how clamp is applied to output values
test_hsigmoid_divisor_assertion: test the HSigmoid constructor to verify it asserts that divisor is not zero
